Users & Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)

Enforcing permissions across Admin, Campus Manager, Faculty, and Student personas

User & Email Role Campus Scope Department Permissions Scope Status

Role Access Control Policy:

  • Admin / Program Manager: Full setup of campuses, semesters, calendars, exam windows, dashboards, and export.
  • Campus Manager: Timetable management and faculty assignment for their campus; receives 48h escalations.
  • Faculty: Upload lesson plans, log sessions for assigned subjects only, access own subject dashboard. Cannot edit other faculty's subjects.
  • Student: Strict read-only view of their batch topics covered, upcoming lectures, exam dates and scope.

Upload syllabus and exam scope

Upload a CSV with one row per topic. Each planned-hour value contributes to weighted course progress. Use an exam ID in the scope column, or leave it blank if the topic is outside the listed exams.

Download the syllabus CSV template

Required columns: SubjectCode, UnitNumber, UnitTitle, TopicName, PlannedHours. Optional: CampusId, TopicId, Sequence, ExamScope, Status, PercentComplete.
ExamScope accepts one or more existing exam IDs separated with |, for example exam_mid_sem|exam_end_sem. Upload replaces the syllabus for each subject included in the file.
